sentences.en: The car was enveloped in a cloud of exhaust fumes.
sentences.zh: 这辆车被一缕尾气形成的云团包围。

sentences.en: Inhaling these fumes could cause damage to your lungs.
sentences.zh: 吸入这些烟雾可能会损害你的肺部。

sentences.en: Toxic fumes of bromine can damage one's lungs.
sentences.zh: 溴的有毒烟雾会损害肺部。

senses.zh: 烟气；激动；空想的事物（fume的复数）
蒸发；冒烟；发怒（fume的三单形式）
